title: M07 — Workloads II — Baseline
description: Read the two non-Deployment controllers the Polyphone fleet runs. StatefulSets give each Pod an ordinal name, a per-Pod DNS name and its own claim, and keep them when you delete the Pod. The sbc-edge DaemonSet runs one Pod per eligible node.

steps.title: Two controllers a Deployment cannot replace
StatefulSet identity: ordinals and per-Pod DNS
StatefulSet storage: one claim per ordinal
Delete a Pod, keep the identity
DaemonSet coverage: one Pod per eligible node
